source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 10.2.1 with the Keep in Mind box, printed page 214.

blocks.text: Kisi bhi atom ya ion ka oxidation number oxidation number ke rules (usool) se nikala ja sakta hai. Yaad rakhein ke oxidation number compound ke ek akele atom ka hota hai.

items: Kisi bhi uncombined (akele, kisi se na jure) element ka oxidation number zero hai. Misal: S₈, H₂, Cl₂, Na, Mg aur Zn mein har atom ka oxidation number zero hai.
Compound ya ion mein zyada electronegative element ko negative oxidation number milta hai. HF mein fluorine ka oxidation number −1 hai.

Compounds mein bohat se atoms ya ions ke oxidation numbers fixed (muqarrar) hain: group 1 alkali metals hamesha +1, group 2 alkaline earth elements hamesha +2, binary compounds mein group 17 halogens hamesha −1, hydrogen +1 (siwaye metal hydrides jaise NaH ke, jahan −1), oxygen −2 (siwaye peroxides ke, jahan −1, aur F₂O ke, jahan +2).
Mono-atomic ion (ek atom wala ion) mein element ka oxidation number hamesha ion ke charge ke barabar hai: Cl⁻ −1 aur Al³⁺ +3.
Compound mein oxidation numbers ka majmooa (sum) zero hai. Neutral molecules, jaise HCl aur NaCl, mein sab elements ke oxidation numbers ka algebraic sum zero hai.
Ion mein oxidation numbers ka algebraic sum ion ke charge ke barabar hai, jaise CO₃²⁻ aur SO₄²⁻ mein.

blocks.text: Agle misalon mein oxidation number ke liye mukhtasar lafz ‘Ox. No.’ istemal hoga.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhein!
blocks.text:
• Hydrogen sab metals ke saath −1 oxidation state dikhata hai.
• Hydrogen sab non-metals ke saath +1 oxidation state dikhata hai.
• Oxygen sab metals ke saath negative oxidation state dikhati hai.
• Oxygen fluorine ke siwa sab non-metals ke saath negative oxidation state dikhati hai.
• Oxygen H₂O, Na₂O₂ aur KO₂ mein bil-tarteeb (respectively) −2, −1 aur −1/2 hai.

blocks.caption: Fixed oxidation numbers ek nazar mein
rows: peroxide mein −1, KO₂ mein −1/2, F₂O mein +2

blocks.prompt: Na₂O₂ mein oxygen ka oxidation number −1 kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Na group 1 hai, is liye har Na +1: 2(+1) + 2(O) = 0, to O = −1. Na₂O₂ peroxide hai, is liye oxygen −2 nahi balkay −1 hai.

items: Element akela ho to 0; zyada electronegative element negative.
Group 1 = +1, group 2 = +2, binary compound mein halogen −1, H +1 (hydride mein −1), O −2 (peroxide −1, F₂O +2).
Mono-atomic ion = us ka charge; compound mein sum 0, ion mein sum = ion ka charge.
